description: This PHP class represents a detailed menu item in the OrangeHRM system, including properties such as ID, title, module, screen, and child menu items. It provides methods to instantiate from a MenuItem entity and manage hierarchical menu structures.

classes.name: DetailedMenuItem
classes.description: Represents a detailed menu item with properties such as ID, title, module, screen, and child menu items. Provides functionality to create instances from MenuItem entities and build menu hierarchies.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the menu item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the menu item.

methods.name: getMenuTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the menu.

methods.name: setMenuTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the menu.

methods.name: getAdditionalParams
methods.description: Returns any additional parameters associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setAdditionalParams
methods.description: Sets additional parameters for the menu item.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module for the menu item.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen URL or object associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen URL or object for the menu item.

methods.name: createFromMenuItem
methods.description: Creates a DetailedMenuItem instance from an existing MenuItem entity, including extracting module and screen information.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child DetailedMenuItem to build hierarchical menu structures.

methods.name: getChildMenuItems
methods.description: Returns the list of child menu items.
